name: C2 Hamiltonian production plan: PILOT, P1 (N=768), P2 (N=1024); fixed-regulator records only
description: Site-neutral: the same rows are run on Expanse or symmetry; the site profiles in cluster/<site>/profile.json hold all scheduler and resource sizing. Re-prioritised after review: the dominant errors are the lambda->0 extrapolation model and the N->infinity extrapolation at the smallest order-1 lambda. Every row keeps oversample 4 / radius_cost 4.5 (the grid family of the archived N=384 records), raises the mixed thermal cutoff from 4096 to 16384 (mixed error ~ lambda^-5) and the leading-tail cutoff from 2048 to 8192, and keeps the collapsed cutoff 800000. A row evaluates its lambda list sequentially on one shared grid. cluster/extension_plan.json is kept unchanged for reference. The PILOT row was run on Expanse on 2026-10-12 (results/expanse/pilot); P1 and P2 have not been run.

science_rules.lambda_N_basis: Numerics reviewer: lambda*N of about 50 (order 1), 60 (order 2) and 75 (order 3) for ~1e-4 spectral accuracy; enforced by submit.py --check.
science_rules.auxiliary_cutoff_basis: Expanse probe at lambda=0.05, order 1 (results/expanse/probe): the selected mixed-sum median moves by 9.4e-7 (8192 -> 16384) and 1.2e-7 (16384 -> 32768); the leading-tail coefficient by 2.3e-4 (4096 -> 8192) and 3.3e-5 (8192 -> 16384) on |A| = 3.07e5.
